title: 第4章  十日之后，我必杀你！
content_zh:
“动我妹妹，你们找死！”
话音落下，方玄如同一头发狂的猎豹，爆冲而出。
“嘭！”
方玄出腿如电，狂暴的力量直接将其中一人踹出数米远，狠狠砸在地上，抽搐了几下就彻底没了动静。
“方玄，你......你敢杀人？”
另外一人见状，顿时大惊失色，满脸骇然的看着方玄。
方尘没有理会他，而是扶起妹妹。
看着小妹方柔身上的累累伤痕，方玄眼眸猩红，透骨杀意自身上散发而出。
“哥，你......”
方柔拉着哥哥方玄，打算劝说。
方玄拨开妹妹的手，将她护在身后，眼神阴狠的看着另外那人。
“方玄，你要做什么？”
那人被吓了一跳，连连后退，颤声道：“我警告你别乱来，家族规矩，族人相残，是要被关进水牢的。”
“我也警告过你们，动我妹妹者，死！”
话一说完，方玄脚掌一跺地面，再次化作一头野兽，冲向对方。
五指握拳，气血喷涌，朝着对方脑袋砸了下去。
这一拳，带着必杀之意。
“方玄小畜生，你给我住手！”
就在此时，一道爆喝声响起。
随即，一道狂暴的气息呼啸而来，直奔方玄。

是方岳，方霄的父亲！
他速度极快，出手之间更是毫不犹豫。
看似是阻止方玄，实则是要彻底毁掉方玄，提前为儿子方霄铺路。
但他快，方玄的速度更快。
那人只觉得眼前一花，方玄就出现在面前，硕大的拳头，携带着令他头皮发麻的力量，重重砸在他的脑袋上。
“二爷，救......”
那人瞳孔一缩，但求救的话还没说完，整个人的意识就变得混沌模糊起来，然后陷入了无边的黑暗。
“噗！”
而在方岳的眼中，是方玄一拳将那名方家人的脑袋轰得粉碎，红的白的撒了一地。
“方、玄！”
愣了一下，方岳双目圆睁，雄浑的真元如同喷发的火山，似要将方玄淹没。
“残杀族人者，当诛！”
方岳目眦欲裂，眼中杀意已经化为实质，竖掌成刀，猛然劈向方玄。
“方岳，你们欺我辱我也就罢了，但想欺负到我妹妹头上，不行！”
方玄面目狰狞，杀意凛然。
面对方岳这强势的一掌，方玄怡然不惧，右手紧握成拳，将周身气血尽数汇聚而起，恶狠狠的砸向方岳。
“轰！”
拳掌相撞，爆发出一道强大的气息，震动四方。
紧接着，方岳和方玄各自后退。
不过方岳在退出半步后，就稳住了身形。

而方玄则是整整后退了三步之多。
感受着手掌上传来的力量，方岳心中一凛。
这小畜生，好恐怖的力量！
虽然他刚才没有动用全力，但那一掌之威，就算是炼体境的武者，也休想完全接下。
但是，方玄不仅接下了，而且还没有受伤。
他的根基，怎地如此恐怖？
连赶来的族人，都难掩脸上的震惊之色。
二爷方岳，虽然不是方家最强者，但也是聚气境巅峰的高手，距离凝元境，也只有一步之遥。
造血境的方玄，竟然与之打成平手。
这还是那个臭名昭著的废柴少主吗？
站稳脚跟，方玄战意盎然，眼神如刀锋般的盯着方岳：“再来！”
方岳双手紧握，双眼死死锁定方玄。
此子武道天赋亘古罕见，绝不能让他继续成长下去！
这一刻的方岳，没来由感到一股强大的压力。
他厉声道：“小畜生，你想死，老子成全你！”
“罪子方玄，公然残杀i族人，今日我就要将之就地斩杀，为我方家清理门户！”
随着这声冷喝落下，方岳体内真元滚动，双手如捣雷，带着令人眼花缭乱的残影，轰向方玄。
“锵锵锵！”
就在此时，一支黑衣蒙面的十人小队突兀出现。
五人持枪，五人握刀。

这十人气息强横，竟然丝毫不弱于方岳。
他们刚一出现，顿时将方岳团团围在中间，杀气腾腾。
“我看谁敢动少主！”
为首一人，长枪直指方岳，露出的双眼，杀意凌厉。
似乎只要方岳有所异动，他就会毫不犹豫出手，将方岳斩杀。
方岳顿时愣住了。
一众方家人，也愣住了。
整个院子，瞬间鸦雀无声，脑海中只有四个字：家族卫队！
家族卫队，乃是方家最强大的底牌之一。
他们或是从方家旁系选拔，或是收养而来的孤儿，自幼受方家培养，平时担任护族及对外征战任务，个个实力强劲，战力超然。
“你们要做什么？”
方岳脸色一沉，冷喝道：“你们还想以下犯上不成？当真是好大的胆子！”
但是这十人卫队理都没理方岳，而是朝着方玄走去。
没有半点犹豫，扑通一声跪在地上。
“第十卫队队长战一，携所有队员，见过少主！”
在战一跪下后，其余九人也齐齐跪下。
动作整齐划一，声音洪亮如钟。
“第十卫队，见过少主！”
方家有十支家族卫队，每支十人，由一名统领统辖。
这一幕，再次让全场哗然。

十名聚气境强者，无论放在哪里，都算得上一股强劲的力量。
而他们，却只听命于一个毛头小子。
方岳脸色愈发难看，冷声道：“方玄已经被罢黜少主之位，你们作为方家护卫，一切当以家族为重。我现在命令你们，立刻杀了方玄，以正家法！”
令所有人震惊的一幕发生了。
“滚！”
战一站起身，瞥了一眼方岳，寒声道：“我们只听命于少主，你算个什么东西，也敢命令我等？”
这时，方岳才恍然想起。
家族卫队，只对家主负责。
忠心耿耿，绝不背叛！
家主不在，效忠于少主。
方家家主方啸天失踪多年，所以他们自然以方玄为首。
与其说是家族卫队，不如说是家主的私人护卫。
想到这一点，方岳的脸色顿时变得铁青无比。
“你们、你们简直岂有此理！”
方岳怒不可遏。
其他人更是头部发麻。
如此精锐的一支力量，居然只听命于方玄？
“再敢聒噪，我先斩你！”
战一身上战意狂飙，真元流动，气机锁定方岳。
没人会怀疑，只要方岳再敢废话一句，战一就会毫不犹豫的出手。

其余九人，也是齐齐上前一步，杀意将方岳笼罩。
“战一。”
方玄轻喝一声，
战一猛的抬手，九名队员纷纷收敛气息，回到方玄身边，恭敬垂首，等待方玄的命令。
看着这一幕，方玄也是哑然失笑。
偌大的方家，血脉亲情，却比不上这些陪他征战四方的兄弟。
方家卫队，本是父亲当年亲自组建的。
亲自教导他们功法，指点武学。
父亲方啸天组建十支卫队，本意是为了保护他们他和母亲妹妹。
在方玄六岁的时候，随着他们外出历练厮杀，经历生死，创下深厚的情谊，早已将方玄当成唯一的主子。
“好，好啊。”
方岳怒极而笑，看向方玄的目光像是能够吃人。
“没曾想，你还有此等手段，当真是小瞧你了。”
方岳本以为，方啸天死了后，以方玄的手腕和实力，根本无法令这些卫队效忠。
所以他一直在等一个机会。
等儿子方霄坐上少主之位后，再慢慢收服这些卫队。
如今一看，这支最强力量，已经是方玄的人了。
“不过你以为，有他们在，你就可以在方家肆无忌惮了吗？”
方岳眼中寒芒闪烁：“方玄，你莫不是忘了，如今的方家，以我这一支为尊！”
众人不由得暗自点头。

虽然方玄大难不死，重新恢复了修为。
但和觉醒了地级武脉的方霄一比，却是一个天上一个地下，两者之间完全没有可比性。
之前一众长老，又宣布了支持方霄。
方玄拿什么和方岳斗？
“哥！”
方柔闻言，害怕的缩在方玄怀中，瘦小的身躯不断发抖。
“小妹不怕，有哥在。”
拍了拍方柔的肩膀，方玄看向方岳，眼中杀意流转。
这方岳，父亲在时就说过，他就像是一条极力忍耐的毒蛇。
一旦给他寻到机会，就会毫不客气露出獠牙，给你一口。
而如今，方玄手中只有十名卫队，真斗起来，确实不是方岳的对手。
方玄最大的依仗从来不是什么家族卫队，而是他自己！
就算修为微弱又如何？
就算实力不如方岳又怎样？
身怀九帝神通的方玄，未必真会怕了方岳这狗贼。
“战一！”
他给战一使了个眼神，后者心领神会，拖着长枪走向方岳。
“放肆！”
见到战一竟然敢以下犯上，方岳顿时勃然大怒。
就在他准备召唤其他长老之际，一道平静的声音缓缓响起。

“父亲稍安勿躁。”
身穿练功服的方霄，缓缓走来，脚步轻松。
“十日之约在即，孩儿要在生死台上，堂堂正正杀了他！”
方霄的声音中，透着十足的信心。
“可是......”
方岳有些犹豫。
方玄大难不死也就罢了，还恢复了修为，能够接住自己一招。
再加上有卫队保护，让他有些担忧。
似乎看出来父亲的顾虑，方霄轻声道：“不过是依靠秘术，强行提升实力罢了，不足为惧。”
“秘术？”
方岳一愣，随即扫了一眼方玄，像是想到了什么。
“原来如此。”
方岳哈哈一笑，说道：“既然如此，那一切就依霄儿所言。”
“小畜生，且让你多活些时日，咱们走。”
方霄离去之前，先是看了眼战一等人，又看向方玄。
“十天后，我就是他们的新主子。”
面对方霄的挑衅，方玄淡然一笑。
“十日之后，我必杀你！”
content_en:
"If you touch my sister, you are seeking death!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Fang Xuan rushed out like a crazy cheetah.
"Bang!"
Fang Xuan's legs were like lightning, and the violent force directly kicked one of them several meters away, slamming him to the ground. He twitched a few times and then completely stopped moving.
"Fang Xuan, you...you dare to kill someone?"
When the other person saw this, he was immediately shocked and looked at Fang Xuan with a horrified face.
Fang Chen ignored him and helped his sister up.
Looking at the numerous scars on his younger sister Fang Rou's body, Fang Xuan's eyes were scarlet, and bone-breaking murderous intent emanated from him.
"Brother, you..."
Fang Rou pulled her brother Fang Xuan and planned to persuade him.
Fang Xuan pushed his sister's hand away, protected her behind him, and looked at the other person with sinister eyes.
"Fang Xuan, what are you going to do?"
The man was startled, backed away, and said in a trembling voice: "I'm warning you not to act recklessly. According to family rules, if you kill each other, you will be imprisoned in a water prison."
"I also warned you, anyone who touches my sister will die!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Fang Xuan stamped his feet on the ground, turned into a beast again, and rushed towards the opponent.
He clenched his fist with five fingers, blood spurted out, and he hit the opponent on the head.
This punch carries the intention of killing.
"Fang Xuan, little beast, stop it!"
At this moment, a loud shout sounded.
Immediately, a violent aura roared towards Fang Xuan.
It's Fang Yue, Fang Xiao's father!
He is extremely fast, and he doesn't hesitate when taking action.
It seems to be to stop Fang Xuan, but in fact it is to completely destroy Fang Xuan and pave the way for his son Fang Xiao in advance.
But he was fast, and Fang Xuan was even faster.
The man's eyes only dimmed as Fang Xuan appeared in front of him. A huge fist, carrying a power that made his scalp numb, hit his head hard.
"Second Master, help..."
The man's pupils shrank, but before he could finish his words for help, his entire consciousness became chaotic and blurred, and then he fell into boundless darkness.
"Poof!"
In Fang Yue's eyes, it was Fang Xuan who smashed the head of the Fang family member into pieces with one punch, scattering red and white all over the floor.
"Fang, Xuan!"
After being stunned for a moment, Fang Yue's eyes widened. The powerful true energy was like an erupting volcano, seeming to drown Fang Xuan.
"Those who kill our clansmen should be punished!"
Fang Yue's eyes were about to burst, and the murderous intent in his eyes had turned into reality. He raised his palm into a knife and struck Fang Xuan suddenly.
"Fang Yue, it's okay for you to bully me, but if you want to bully my sister, you can't!"
Fang Xuan's face was ferocious and his murderous intent was stern.
Facing Fang Yue's powerful palm, Fang Xuan was not afraid. He clenched his right hand into a fist, gathered all the energy and blood from his body, and smashed Fang Yue viciously.
"Boom!"
The fists and palms collided, and a powerful aura erupted, shaking all directions.
Immediately afterwards, Fang Yue and Fang Xuan retreated.
However, Fang Yue stabilized his figure after taking half a step back.
Fang Xuan took three full steps back.
Feeling the power coming from his palm, Fang Yue's heart trembled.
This little beast is so terrifying!
Although he didn't use all his strength just now, even a warrior in the body refining realm couldn't fully grasp the power of that palm.
However, Fang Xuan not only took it, but he was also not injured.
Why is his foundation so terrifying?
Even the tribesmen who came over couldn't hide the shock on their faces.
Although the second master Fang Yue is not the strongest in the Fang family, he is still a master at the peak of the Qi Gathering Realm and is only one step away from the Condensing Yuan Realm.
Fang Xuan, who was in the blood-making realm, actually tied with him.
Is this still the infamous good-for-nothing young master?
Standing firm, Fang Xuan was full of fighting spirit, staring at Fang Yue with his eyes like blades: "Come again!"
Fang Yue clenched his hands and locked his eyes firmly on Fang Xuan.
This child's martial arts talent is extremely rare, and we must not allow him to continue to grow!
At this moment, Fang Yue felt a strong pressure for no reason.
He said sternly: "Little beast, you want to die, I will help you! "
"The guilty son Fang Xuan openly killed members of the I clan. Today I will kill him on the spot to clear the door for our Fang family! "
As the cold shout fell, the true energy in Fang Yue's body rolled, and his hands were like thunder, blasting towards Fang Xuan with a dazzling afterimage.
“Clang, clang, clang! "
At this moment, a ten-man team dressed in black and masked suddenly appeared.
Five held guns and five held knives.
The auras of these ten people were strong and tyrannical, and they were not weaker than Fang Yue at all.
As soon as they appeared, they immediately surrounded Fang Yue with murderous intent.
"Let's see who dares to touch the young master! "
The leader pointed his spear directly at Fang Yue, his exposed eyes filled with murderous intent.
It seemed that as long as Fang Yue made any move, he would take action without hesitation and kill Fang Yue.
Fang Yue was stunned immediately.
All the Fang family members were also stunned.
The whole courtyard was silent for a moment, and there were only four words in my mind: Family Guard!
The family guard is one of the Fang family's most powerful trump cards.
They are either selected from the side lines of the Fang family or adopted orphans. They have been trained by the Fang family since they were young. They usually serve as guardians of the clan and on foreign expeditions. They are all strong and have extraordinary combat prowess.
"What are you going to do? "
Fang Yue's face darkened and he shouted coldly: "Do you still want to commit the following crime? What a courage! "
But the ten guards ignored Fang Yue and walked towards Fang Xuan.
Without any hesitation, he knelt on the ground with a plop.
"The captain of the 10th Guards, Zhan Yi, together with all his team members, has met the young master! "
After Zhan Yi knelt down, the other nine people also knelt down.
His movements were uniform and his voice was as loud as a bell.
"The 10th Guards have met the young master! "
The Fang family has ten family guards, each with ten people and led by a commander.
This scene once again caused an uproar in the entire audience.
Ten Qi Gathering Realm powerhouses can be considered a powerful force no matter where they are placed.
But they only took orders from a young boy.
Fang Yue's face became increasingly ugly, and he said coldly: "Fang Xuan has been deposed as the young master. As the guards of the Fang family, you should put the family first in everything. I now order you to kill Fang Xuan immediately to rectify the family law! "
A scene that shocked everyone happened.
"Get out! "
Zhan Yi stood up, glanced at Fang Yue, and said in a cold voice: "We only obey orders from the young master, who do you think you are, and you dare to order me to wait? "
At this moment, Fang Yue suddenly remembered.
The family guard is only responsible to the head of the family.
Be loyal and never betray!
The master of the house is away, so he is loyal to the young master.
The head of the Fang family, Fang Xiaotian, has been missing for many years, so they naturally take Fang Xuan as their leader.
Rather than being a family guard, it is better to say that it is the family head's personal guard.
Thinking of this, Fang Yue's face suddenly turned livid.
"You, you are simply unreasonable! "
Fang Yue was furious.
Others even had numbness in their heads.
Such an elite force actually only takes orders from Fang Xuan?
"If you dare to make any noise again, I will kill you first! "
The fighting spirit in Zhan Yi surged, his true energy flowed, and his energy locked onto Fang Yue.
No one would doubt that as long as Fang Yue dared to talk nonsense again, Zhan Yi would take action without hesitation.
The other nine people also took a step forward, shrouding Fang Yue with murderous intent.
“Zhan Yi. "
Fang Xuan drank softly,
Zhan Yi fiercely raised his hand, and the nine team members gathered their breath and returned to Fang Xuan. They bowed their heads respectfully and waited for Fang Xuan's order.
Looking at this scene, Fang Xuan also burst into laughter.
The huge Fang family has blood and family ties, but it can't compare to these brothers who accompany him to fight in all directions.
The Fang family guard was originally organized by my father himself.
He personally taught them exercises and martial arts.
His father Fang Xiaotian formed ten guards with the original intention of protecting him and his mother and sister.
When Fang Xuan was six years old, as they went out to experience fighting, experienced life and death, and established a deep friendship, Fang Xuan had already been regarded as his only master.
"Okay, okay. "Fang Yue laughed angrily and looked at Fang Xuan with a look that could eat people.
"I never thought that you had such means. I really underestimate you."
Fang Yue originally thought that after Fang Xiaotian died, Fang Xuan's skills and strength would not be able to make these guards loyal.
So he has been waiting for an opportunity.
After his son Fang Xiao takes the position of young master, he will slowly conquer these guards.
Now, at a glance, this strongest force is already Fang Xuan's.
"But do you think that with them here, you can be unscrupulous in the Fang family?"
Fang Yue's eyes flashed coldly: "Fang Xuan, have you forgotten that the Fang family now respects my branch!"
Everyone couldn't help but nodded secretly.
Although Fang Xuan survived the disaster and recovered his cultivation level.
But compared with Fang Xiao, who has awakened the earth-level martial arts, he is in the sky and on the ground. There is no comparison between the two.
A group of elders previously announced their support for Fang Xiao.
What does Fang Xuan use to fight Fang Yue?
"Brother!"
When Fang Rou heard this, she shrank in Fang Xuan's arms in fear, her thin body trembling continuously.
"Don't be afraid, little sister, brother is here."
Patting Fang Rou on the shoulder, Fang Xuan looked at Fang Yue, with murderous intent flowing in his eyes.
This Fang Yue, his father said when he was still alive, was like a poisonous snake trying to endure.
Once he finds an opportunity, he will unceremoniously show his fangs and give you a bite.
But now, Fang Xuan only has ten guards in his hands. In a real fight, he is indeed no match for Fang Yue.
Fang Xuan's biggest reliance has never been on any family guards, but on himself!
So what if the cultivation level is weak?
So what if his strength is not as good as Fang Yue's?
Fang Xuan, who possesses the magical power of the Nine Emperors, may not really be afraid of Fang Yue, a thief.
"Zhan Yi!"
He glanced at Zhan Yi, who understood and dragged his spear towards Fang Yue.
"Presumptuous!"
Seeing that Zhan Yi dared to commit such a crime, Fang Yue suddenly became furious.
Just as he was about to summon the other elders, a calm voice slowly sounded.
"Father, please be patient."
Fang Xiao, who was wearing training clothes, walked slowly with an easy step.
"The ten-day appointment is coming soon. The child will be on the stage of life and death, and he will be killed in a dignified way!"
Fang Xiao's voice was full of confidence.
"But..."
Fang Yue hesitated.
Fang Xuan survived the catastrophe. He also recovered his cultivation and was able to catch one of his own moves.
Coupled with the fact that he was protected by guards, it made him a little worried.
As if he could see his father's concerns, Fang Xiao said softly: "It's just relying on secret techniques to forcibly increase the strength. It's nothing to be afraid of."
"Secret technique?"
Fang Yue was stunned for a moment, then glanced at Fang Xuan, as if he had thought of something.
"That's it."
Fang Yue laughed and said, "In that case, everything is as Xiao'er said."
"Little beast, let you live a little longer, let's go."
Before Fang Xiao left, he first looked at Zhan Yi and others, and then looked at Fang Xuan.
"In ten days, I will be their new master."
Facing Fang Xiao's provocation, Fang Xuan smiled calmly.
"In ten days, I will kill you!"
